basic_info.description: Perched on one of Clarendon Heights' most coveted blocks, 44 Mountain Spring Avenue is a panoramic view home that showcases the very best of the city's  iconic skyline. From the Golden Gate Bridge and Marin Headlands to Downtown, Buena  Vista Park, the East Bay, and Mt. Diablo, nearly every landmark unfolds before you. This expansive mid-century modern residence offers exceptional scale, abundant light, and unforgettable vistas from nearly every room  all just minutes from the heart of San Francisco. Incredible entertaining space with large scale rooms, including four bedrooms and three baths on the main living level, multiple open living areas, original wood paneled dining room, updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and large laundry room. The second floor is dedicated to a massive 700+ square foot primary suite, featuring a spacious, light filled bedroom with views in every direction, from the North Bay and Golden Gate Bridge to the East Bay and Mt. Diablo. Additioanl amenities include gated front patio area, rear garden and large two car side by side garage with internal access. Incredibly special home, not to be missed!
